summary: This approach session reaches the same priest.c:intemple() name-formatting defect as the related no-carry Sanctum session. At step 130, C emits “The high priestess intones:” after clearing priest->ispriest and calling Monnam(); JavaScript clears ispriest but calls priestname() directly, whose ordinary-monster early return omits ARTICLE_THE and produces “High priestess intones:”. This is corroborating runtime evidence for the same divergence-fix scope, not a separate source task.

source.branch: A visible, non-hallucinated hero teleports into a Sanctum TEMPLE room while a speaking high priestess is present and intone_time has elapsed. intemple() saves priest->ispriest, clears it for Monnam(), emits the introduction, then restores the value before scheduling the next intone.
callers: teleport.c:teleds() calls spoteffects(TRUE) after relocation; hack.c:spoteffects() calls check_special_room(FALSE); hack.c:check_special_room() calls intemple() for an entered TEMPLE.
JavaScript mirrors this route through teleport.js:teleds(), hack.js:spoteffects(), rooms.js:check_special_room(), and priest.js:intemple().
dependencies: priest.c:intemple() calls do_name.c:Monnam(priest) after temporarily clearing ispriest. The existing canonical js/do_name.js:Monnam() delegates to x_monnam(), whose ordinary-species path retains ARTICLE_THE after the priest/minion special case no longer applies.

evidence: Queue actionable from 7 current sessions at SHA-256 8e3cc52f29759118832c5b4a20bc5b578638d7adccd7c89524d205a4916496ff records challenges/evaluations/accepted-671938b9bce6f6f152d2f38a1cc5b3db8e38e36c-v45.json at 671938b9bce6f6f152d2f38a1cc5b3db8e38e36c, with 2 remaining screens and first divergence at segment 0, step 130.

The recorded step 130 is input `.`. Its C RNG entry is d(10,500)=2204 at priest.c:443; the full recorded screen says “You materialize in a different location!  The high priestess intones:”. Queue comparison reports C row 0, column 42 as `T` and JavaScript as `H`, while all 7856 recorded C RNG calls still match at that first visual divergence.

nethack-c/upstream/src/priest.c:intemple() lines 430-444 temporarily sets priest->ispriest to zero for a visible non-hallucinated Sanctum introduction, then calls Monnam(priest) and restores the saved field. nethack-c/upstream/src/do_name.c:x_monnam() lines 876-885 bypasses its priestname() case after that temporary clear and applies ARTICLE_THE to mon_pmname(priest).

js/priest.js:intemple() lines 817-832 performs the temporary ispriest clear but directly calls priestname(priest, ARTICLE_THE, false) and highc(). js/priest.js:priestname() lines 718-722 returns mon_pmname() immediately when both ispriest and isminion are false, dropping the article. Use the existing Monnam(priest, state) at this caller.

The no-carry Sanctum companion v45-offer-real-amulet-sanctum-no-carry-teleport-attempt28-cfirst reaches the same C d(10,500) branch at step 73 and the same `T` versus `H` boundary. The two sessions therefore share priest.c:intemple and should be bundled under one fix.
